parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The image visibility. Valid values:
- Public: visible to all users.
- Private: visible only to the creator.

parameters.name: AcrAssociatedVpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID associated with the ACR instance. This parameter is required when referencing an ACR image.

parameters.name: AcrInstanceId
parameters.description: The Container Registry (ACR) instance ID. This parameter is required when referencing an ACR image.

parameters.name: ImageUri
parameters.description: The image URI. This parameter is required when referencing an ACR image.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The image namespace. Set this parameter to DataWorks Default when referencing a DataWorks official image.

parameters.name: ProviderImageId
parameters.description: The provider image ID. This parameter is required when referencing a DataWorks official image.

parameters.name: RepositoryName
parameters.description: The image repository name. Set this parameter to DataWorks Default when referencing a DataWorks official image.
